title: MACHEREY-NAGEL NucleoMag® Tissue Protocol
author: MACHEREY-NAGEL
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Perform sample lysis
steps.instruction: Carry out lysis of the tissue samples following the NucleoMag® Tissue user manual.

steps.title: Fill buffer reservoir
steps.instruction: Fill the 12‑well buffer reservoir with the reagents specified in the protocol table.

steps.title: Resuspend magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Vortex the NucleoMag® B‑Beads to resuspend them, then place the bead suspension in Position A1 of the 2 mL tube rack.

steps.title: Load OT‑2 deck
steps.instruction: Arrange all labware on the OT‑2 deck according to the displayed positions (tip racks, buffer reservoir, square‑well block, etc.).

steps.title: Start magnetic bead run
steps.instruction: Place the square‑well block containing the lysates on the magnetic module and start the automated run.

substeps.instruction: Place the square‑well block containing the lysates on the magnetic module.
Start the run on the OT‑2.

steps.title: Binding step
steps.instruction: The robot adds binding buffer to the lysates, mixes, and allows nucleic acids to bind to the magnetic beads.

steps.title: First wash
steps.instruction: The robot performs the first wash of the bead‑bound nucleic acids.

steps.title: Second wash
steps.instruction: The robot performs the second wash of the bead‑bound nucleic acids.

steps.title: Third wash
steps.instruction: The robot performs the third wash of the bead‑bound nucleic acids.

steps.title: Dry beads
steps.instruction: The robot pauses for a drying delay to remove residual wash buffer from the beads.

steps.title: Elute nucleic acids
steps.instruction: The robot adds elution buffer, mixes, and transfers the purified nucleic‑acid solution to the elution plate.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the required protocol parameters (volumes, times, etc.) into the OT‑2 interface as prompted.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the protocol Python file from the provided link and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More > Custom Labware > Add Labware and upload any required .json labware files.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s Protocol tab, upload the .py protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck map
steps.instruction: Configure the deck layout in the OT App to match the physical arrangement of labware on the robot.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT App to calibrate tip racks, labware, and the pipette.

steps.title: Run protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the automated NucleoMag® Tissue workflow.
